Pre-publication candidate for Copy All Note. This release remained an unpublished draft; 0.1.1 is the first public publication candidate.

- Copy the active note's complete live Markdown from a native header action or the **Copy entire note** command.
- Keep or remove leading YAML frontmatter, optionally prepend the note title, show or hide the header action and success notice, and customize the action icon.
- Copy unsaved edits and valid empty buffers, preserving retained frontmatter structure. Obsidian may normalize CRLF line endings and remove a leading BOM before supplying the live buffer, so original file-byte preservation is not guaranteed.
- Use split panes and pop-out windows without falling back to stale disk content.

The 0.1.0 manifest declared Obsidian 1.5.0 as its minimum, but compatibility with that exact version was not verified. The 0.1.1 candidate raises the minimum to the natively tested Obsidian 1.13.7. This historical note does not change the existing 0.1.0 tag or its draft assets.

The plugin runs locally, makes no network requests, collects no telemetry, and processes note text locally only to copy it to the clipboard.
